Strategy: Take the second-loosest bin. Skip the loosest feasible bin, saving it for the biggest future item, and use the next loosest instead. Score by distance from the second-largest residual, so ranking can differ from Best Fit whenever the loosest bin is available. It may help by reserving maximum space, but may fail by wasting roomy bins while tighter ones strand.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    mx = max(bins)
    below = [r for r in bins if r < mx]
    s2 = max(below) if len(below) > 0 else mx
    return [-abs(r - s2) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Second-loosest targeting: prefer bin whose residual is closest to second-largest residual.
